meta.title: Hoi An Vietnam Travel Guide 🇻🇳 | Lanterns, Coconut Boat Ride & Night Market
meta.description:
🏮 **Planning a trip to Hoi An, Vietnam?** Wondering about the best places to visit in Hoi An, the famous lantern streets, coconut basket boat ride, night market, and how to explore this beautiful Vietnamese town?

Welcome to **Hoi An, one of Vietnam's most magical destinations!** 🇻🇳✨

In this Hoi An Vietnam Travel Guide in Hindi and English, we're exploring the beautiful lantern-lit streets, traditional Vietnamese architecture, colourful markets, and unforgettable experiences that make Hoi An a must-visit destination on your Vietnam itinerary.

If you're planning a Vietnam trip from India, this video will help you discover what makes Hoi An special and how to include it in your trip.

📍 **BEST THINGS TO DO IN HOI AN, VIETNAM**

🏮 **Hoi An Ancient Town** – Explore charming yellow buildings, traditional streets, colourful lanterns and picturesque cafes.

🚣 **Coconut Basket Boat Ride** – Discover the famous basket boat experience at Cam Thanh Coconut Village, one of the most popular activities near Hoi An.

🌙 **Hoi An Night Market** – Experience beautiful lantern displays, souvenir shopping, street food and the magical evening atmosphere.

🌉 **Japanese Covered Bridge** – Discover one of Hoi An's most iconic historical landmarks.

📸 **Hoi An Lantern Streets** – Explore the beautiful streets that make Hoi An one of Vietnam's most photogenic destinations.

✈️ **PLANNING HOI AN FROM INDIA?**

Hoi An is often visited along with Da Nang, making it a great addition to a Central Vietnam itinerary.
